Job Purpose :

This role represents a high-profile mandate within the organization, ICT & Services Product Growth Specialist drives revenue growth for the company's ICT hardware and software portfolio. The role owns the product's go-to-market execution, manages commercial relationships with principals and distributors, supports sales with proposals, and tracks revenue performance per product segment for management reporting.

The role leads and manages ICT & Services revenue growth enablement by taking full accountability for shaping GTM propositions and ensuring investment business realization across the ICT & Services portfolio. Acting as the product owner, the role influences strategic decisions on product direction, monetization priorities, and pricing strategy ensuring strong alignment between market demand, network capabilities, and financial objectives in Enterprise B2B market.

Delivers direct and measurable impact on enterprise revenue growth, project win rates, GTM effectiveness, and portfolio profitability. Improves Assets investment returns through, optimized asset utilization, revenue boost program and cost efficiency initiatives. Strengthens the sustainability and competitiveness of the ICT & Services business by accelerating time-to-market, enhancing value propositions, and ensuring long-term monetization of network assets in support of Enterprise Business growth objectives.

Education : Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or Information Technology

Experience : Min. 3 - 6 years of experience in ICT & Services product engagement, marketing, or related roles.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

Carry out daily Parent Stock farm activities according to work instructions and SOPs.
Perform routine tasks such as feeding, egg collection, cleaning, and flock care.
Observe and report flock conditions, mortality, and operational abnormalities to the supervisor.
Follow biosecurity, animal welfare, safety, and hygiene requirements at all times.
Maintain cleanliness of facilities, equipment, and work areas.
Record daily operational data accurately as instructed.
Support team activities to ensure smooth and efficient farm operations.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
